purpose: Teach: 勤勉/トラベル/平易/気概/描ける/むい/夏目/偶像

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「勤勉な姿勢を続ければ報われる」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said, 'if you keep at things diligently, it always pays off.'
lines.style: Warm passing-on-wisdom tone, the quote delivered slower and lower, an encouraging lift to close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと家族でトラベルブックを見ながら旅行計画したよ
lines.en: Mama, me and Dad looked at the travel book and planned our family trip!
lines.style: Bubbling but small-voiced excitement, quickening pace, joy peeking out on 'trip'.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「平易な言葉で説明してくれる」って助かるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad puts everything into such plain, simple words — it really is a help.
lines.style: Relaxed appreciative sigh in the voice, easy mid-pace, genuine gratitude at the close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「気概を持って取り組んで」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mama, Dad told me to 'take things on with real fighting spirit.'
lines.style: Sitting up straighter as he repeats it, careful serious quote, a determined little nod at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「絵が上手に描けるね」って褒めて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad praised you, you know — 'you've gotten so good at drawing.'
lines.style: Bright proud lilt, leaning into the compliment, savoring her son's reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「リンゴをむいて食べた」よ
lines.en: Mama, me and Dad peeled an apple and ate it together.
lines.style: Simple happy report, soft even pace, quiet satisfaction rounding off the sentence.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが夏目漱石の小説を読んでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's in there reading a Natsume Soseki novel.
lines.style: Soft observational murmur, a fond glance in the voice, gentle fall at the sentence end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「偶像、つまり偶像崇拝にならない様に」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mama, Dad taught me about idols — like, not to turn things into idol worship.
lines.style: Careful, slightly puzzled repetition of a grown-up idea, slow serious effort to get it right.
